name: watch-this
//overrides: Every entry below must earn its place: an override silently violates what a
dependency declared it can work with, so it is only worth it to reach a
patched version the tree cannot otherwise resolve.
postcss ^8.5.18 -- load-bearing. Without it the tree also resolves 8.4.31
and 8.5.15, both inside GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 (high, <=8.5.17).
sharp ^0.35.3 -- load-bearing. Without it sharp drops to 0.34.5, inside
GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj (high, <0.35.0).
@types/react, @types/react-dom -- pinned to match the react/react-dom
versions exactly; React 19 types are not compatible across minors.
SUPPLY-13: brace-expansion is deliberately NOT overridden, and
GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (high, DoS via unbounded expansion, vulnerable
<=5.0.7) is knowingly left OPEN on the paths that cannot reach 5.0.8.
brace-expansion 5.x changed its export from `module.exports = expand` to
`{ expand }`, and the four minimatch copies here straddle that break:
minimatch@3.1.5 wants ^1.1.7, minimatch@9.0.9 wants ^2.0.2 (both call the
import directly), minimatch@10.2.5 wants ^5.0.5 (calls .expand). So no
single pin works. Forcing ^5.0.8 makes `eslint .` die with exit 2 --
'expand is not a function' inside @eslint/config-array; forcing ^2.1.2
(what was here before) instead breaks minimatch@10 under test-exclude, so
`vitest --coverage` crashes. Unpinned, every consumer resolves a version
compatible with the API it expects, and the one that declares ^5.0.5 gets
5.0.8, which is patched.
Not fixed by choice, not by omission: the remaining vulnerable copies (1.x
and 2.x) are dev-only, reached through minimatch inside the ESLint
toolchain, which runs over this repo's own trusted source. `npm audit fix`
only offers an eslint major change, a bigger risk than the advisory.
Revisit when eslint-config-next and the a11y/react plugins move off
minimatch@3/@9.
SUPPLY-04: ajv, @babel/core, flatted, ws and js-yaml were removed because
the tree resolves to the same patched versions without them. picomatch was
removed for a stronger reason: it forced micromatch (which declares ^2.3.1)
across two majors to 4.0.4, and micromatch's own resolution is 2.3.2 --
already the patched version, since the advisories are ranged <2.3.2. It
bought nothing and violated a declared range.
SUPPLY-05: esbuild is deliberately NOT overridden. Four consumers declare
mutually disjoint ranges (vite ^0.27.0, tsx ~0.28.0, drizzle-kit ^0.25.4,
@esbuild-kit/core-utils ~0.18.20), so no single version satisfies them and
any blanket pin violates three of the four. The old ^0.28.1 pin was for
GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr, which was WITHDRAWN on 2026-06-17. It was also masking
two live advisories that now show in `npm audit`: GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99
(moderate, <=0.24.2, via the deprecated @esbuild-kit/core-utils) and
GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr (low, >=0.27.3 <0.28.1, via vite). Both are dev-only
and both are `esbuild serve` vulnerabilities; nothing here runs the esbuild
dev server -- esbuild is used purely as a transform library. Re-pinning to
clear them would reintroduce exactly the semver violation removed here.
